rationale: r2gaussian-claude-agentic: val_n=15, gs_n_gaussians=1024, gs_n_iter=130, gs_lr_pos=0.005, gs_lr_scale=0.01, gs_lr_amp=0.01, gs_lr_rot=0.01, gs_amp_init=0.01, gs_scale_init=0.04, gs_tv_weight=0.0001, gs_n_clip=0.05, gs_init_from_fbp=True, gs_render=raster, gs_ssim_weight=0.3, seed=42, train_n=0, rationale=iter-6 (search-20260703-01). ONE KNOB: gs_ssim_weight 0.15->0.30 (map the SSIM-loss axis -- the single most effective lever so far). Base = iter-5 BEST (warm-start ON, 1024G/130it, SSIM-loss). PRIOR NUMBERS: iter-1 0.8032/20.14 (cold 512G), iter-2 0.8048/20.32 (steps FLAT), iter-3 0.8145/20.38 (1024G capacity), iter-4 0.8539/22.50 (warm-start +0.039), iter-5 0.9264/28.55 (SSIM-loss@0.15, BEST -- +0.0725 SSIM and +6.0 dB PSNR, the biggest lift). hr pinned 0 at EVERY iter (iter-5 PSNR 28.55 still 7.4 dB below the 128-view FBP baseline 35.97). FAILURE MODE: coarse Gaussian basis; but warm-start + SSIM-loss is closing the gap toward the FBP floor faster than any other lever (unlike Mayo, where SSIM-weight TRADED PSNR down; on breast it lifts BOTH -- the warm-start FBP target is high-quality here). HYPOTHESIS (falsifiable in NUMBERS): doubling the SSIM pull (0.15->0.30) lifts SSIM above 0.9264 and PSNR toward 35.97; if PSNR crosses ~36 dB / RMSE drops below the FBP baseline RMSE, hr goes >0 (the live shot at clearing baseline). FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.9264 (no lift) OR PSNR drops, the SSIM-weight axis is saturated/over-weighted -> the coarse-basis ceiling holds and hr stays 0. val_n=15 HELD CONSTANT (gs_outer_wall_s=1080). BUDGET: SSIM term ~1 conv/step -> same ~660s as iter-5 << 1080 wall. TRAJECTORY: iter-4 0.8539 (warm) -> iter-5 0.9264 (SSIM@0.15, BEST) -> iter-6 SSIM@0.30 push., gs_outer_wall_s=1080, gs_amp_init_max=0.05
